name: SMBEXEL Company
summary: SMBEXEL Company manufactures and sells automobile parts and various types of batteries in South Korea. The company offers water pumps, oil pumps, auto parts, AL cylinder heads, and modules for automobile assembly, and specialized parts companies. It also offers batteries, such as alkaline and manganese batteries, as well as special batteries, including nickel hydrogen, lithium-ion, vehicle starting batteries, industrial battery packs, and military battery packs, and has expanded into ampoule batteries for defense applications; and building and housing rental and sales.
